Bladehold Icon Swap

Applied 2026-10-07. Every gold-framed icon is now in the game as a gi_* sprite.

Every draft card, meta perk and shop item, showing its current icon beside two game-icons.net candidates. The gold frame marks my pick. The candidate SVGs are saved in GameIcons/picks/<group>/<id>/, and the full set of 4,180 icons is in GameIcons/all/.

Before importing

game-icons.net icons are licensed CC BY 3.0. Credit each author whose icon we ship in CREDITS.md. The author is the second name under each candidate.

The candidates are plain white silhouettes on transparent backgrounds. Run the picks through /generate-sprite-variants to get the Synty Clean, Underlay and Stroke treatment, so they match the rest of the card art.
